headings.quote: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
headings.note: 1:1 gives “the twentieth year” without naming the king; 2:1 dates the next scene to “the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king”.

dated.quote: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
dated.why: Nehemiah’s account of building the wall runs on with no new year from 2:1 to the wall’s finishing at 6:15.

dated.quote: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

dated.quote: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
dated.note: Scripture says only “Darius the Persian”; the site keeps him as a different person record from the Darius of Ezra 4–6. He has no ruler page.

dated.quote: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
